item.title: Saturday Morning, Nov 7
item.description:
The Saturday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 7, 2026: Londonderry weather with the seven-day outlook; more Justice Department departures after the midterms, the court-blocked triumphal arch, and a new federal homelessness count; Russian missiles hit Kyiv ahead of Tuesday's peace talks in Abu Dhabi, Iran lifts its missile-range limit, another deadly attack on worshippers in Ethiopia, and a too-close-to-call New Zealand election; a weekend look at the worst week for stocks in more than a year; SpaceX plans a double Starship catch; Mira Murati's Thinking Machines nears a big raise and OpenAI drops data-center NDAs; a SonicWall flaw under attack; your X feed; Veterans Day weekend events around Derry and Londonderry; and twenty-five thousand people who bought an 800-year-old estate for wildlife. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Friday Morning, Nov 6
